caption: A metal bucket half full of water is struck once with a stick, and the water inside jumps into ripples.

sa.check: A metal bucket half full of water.
A stick strikes the bucket once.
The water surface jumps into ripples.
The strike is a single hit.
The strike comes first and the ripples follow.

pc.expect: The surface is still until the strike and the ripples begin at it.
pc.fail: Ripples run over the surface before the stick lands; or appear with the stick held away; or the stick lands and the surface stays glassy.

pc.expect: The ripples are a fine shiver over the whole surface that fades; the water does not slosh.
pc.fail: The water sloshes up one side as if the bucket had been tipped; or a single ring spreads from the centre as if something had been dropped in; or the ripples grow stronger after the strike; or the water leaps out of the bucket.

pc.expect: The water stays level in the bucket and any drops fall back.
pc.fail: Water rises out of the bucket; or the surface stays tilted; or the bucket lifts.

pc.expect: The bucket is rigid metal and the stick rebounds from it.
pc.fail: The stick sinks into the bucket wall; or the bucket crumples like paper; or the bucket wall ripples like cloth.

pc.expect: One bucket, one stick; the water keeps its amount.
pc.fail: A second bucket appears; or the stick passes through the bucket; or the water vanishes; or the bucket changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bucket's colour, the water's colour and the stick stay the same.
pc.fail: The bucket changes colour; or the water changes colour; or the stick changes length.

note: The hand on the stick is a trigger and is not judged.
